Forgebound art validation - PASS

1264 files: 1208 PASS / 56 WARN / 0 FAIL. Total PNG size 34.99 MB.

Automated checks verify technical correctness (format, alpha, halos, cropping, provenance, budgets, duplicates, legibility heuristics). They do NOT certify aesthetic quality; a human art review against the qualitative checkpoints is required before assets are considered final.

Qualitative review checkpoints

  1. Silhouette: each Frame reads as its weapon class from silhouette alone (fill shapes black and compare).
  2. Core identity: each Core is recognisable by gem SHAPE as well as colour (check in greyscale / colour-blind simulation).
  3. Value structure: clear light/shadow split, no muddy mid-tone soup; key light from upper-left on everything.
  4. Hand-painted feel: painted-noise breakup visible but not dirty; outlines even and not broken.
  5. Tier read: tier 3 visibly richer than tier 1 (gold trim, ornaments) without becoming noisy.
  6. Legendary read: unique accent silhouette + glow layer feels special yet the Frame is still identifiable.
  7. Animation: idle loops without a pop between last and first frame; attack has clear anticipation, impact and recovery.
  8. In-context: view sprites over the actual battle backgrounds and UI panels at phone scale (48-64 px icons).
  9. Style consistency: weapons, board pieces and characters look like one game (same outline weight, light rig, palette).
  10. Originality: no resemblance to existing game IP (shapes, emblems, characters).
